title: x-FuSa Common Header
description: §3.1: every JSON document emitted by an x-FuSa tool carries this header. The version --format json response is the only exception (it carries specVersion instead).

schemaVersion.description: Spec MAJOR.MINOR the document conforms to (§2.8).

kind.description: Document-type discriminator (§3.1). A consumer MUST treat unknown values as opaque.

language.description: Language id from §1.1 registry. A consumer MUST treat unknown values as opaque.
